description: Implementation class for generic entity service handling CRUD operations and entity management using DAO pattern in a SalesManager application.

classes.name: SalesManagerEntityServiceImpl
classes.description: Abstract generic service implementation for handling sales manager entities, providing standard CRUD operations and utility methods.

methods.name: SalesManagerEntityServiceImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing DAO and determining entity class via reflection.

methods.name: getObjectClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the managed entity.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by class and ID using DAO.

methods.name: getByField
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by a specified field and value.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists an entity, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new entity, delegating to createEntity.

methods.name: createEntity
methods.description: Creates an entity, a protected method for extensibility.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an entity, delegating to updateEntity.

methods.name: updateEntity
methods.description: Updates an entity, a protected method for extensibility.

methods.name: listByField
methods.description: Lists entities filtered by a specific field and value.
